from decimal import ROUND_CEILING, Decimal

MIN_FEE_MINOR = 30


def platform_fee(gross_minor, rate_bps):
    """Return the platform fee, in minor units, on a payout of `gross_minor` at `rate_bps` basis points.

    The fee is rounded up to the next minor unit so the platform never
    under-collects (seller agreement, clause 7.2), and is at least
    MIN_FEE_MINOR per payout.
    """
    fee = (Decimal(gross_minor) * Decimal(rate_bps) / Decimal(10_000)).to_integral_value(
        rounding=ROUND_CEILING
    )
    return max(int(fee), MIN_FEE_MINOR)
